notes.subject: ויענני
notes.rationale: mačči d talɣa kan deg taqbaylit; yeffeɣ-d deg tira n tsuqilt

notes.subject: ur numin ara
notes.rationale: Iyov yerrent awal-agi akken d aḥeqq n yiwen kan, imi yeqqar belli Ṛebbi ur yettaram ara ad yissin ma yella yeεreḍ ad yessawel

notes.subject: يַאֲזִין
notes.rationale: aεqqeb deg teqbaylit ɣef 'yessferḍ iṭijen' d ayen yellan deg tira tamaziɣt, imi d ayen iḥerfan ara ad d-yefk

notes.subject: Iyov
notes.rationale: awal agi d ayen nnettat i d-yennan ɣef yiḥeqq-is d Ṛebbi

translation: Ma lliɣ yeɛreḍ ⟨i⟩ yessawel-ed, ur numin ara yerna ur lliɣ ara ad numin belli yesla i ṣṣut-iw, axaṭer ur yessineṛ ara ma yella deg-s ṣṣut-iw.
